run_science_runner: run a ScienceRunner instance for a configured number of iterations using Hydra config
shutdown_science_runner: gracefully shut down a running ScienceRunner instance and cancel all pending async tasks
resume_preempted_run: resume a preempted experiment run by loading the existing config.yaml from the workspace
instantiate_science_runner: instantiate a ScienceRunner or BoNScienceRunner from Hydra config using hydra.utils.instantiate
handle_signals: register SIGINT and SIGTERM signal handlers to trigger graceful shutdown of the science runner
